principles: Text, numerals, and chart geometry use the handwriting treatment; annotation marks explain attention and never carry unsupported facts.
Exact text, numbers, source notes, and chart labels stay deterministic.
Paper space and line rhythm matter more than decorative density.
The style can be quiet and professional; it must not become childish doodling.

prompt_or_context.treatment: small neutral capsule or metadata line

evidence_chart.axis: black deterministic hand-drawn vector path with generous whitespace
evidence_chart.series: green deterministic hand-drawn line or mark

source_boundary.treatment: small readable neutral text, never hidden by marker

route_adapters.response: Use short clauses, sparse visual punctuation, and explicit boundary lines; no font claim.
route_adapters.image-report: Use deterministic handwritten text/numeral layers and hand-drawn vector chart geometry; marker and ink remain separate vector overlays.
route_adapters.web-ppt-html: Use CSS variables and inline SVG; preserve a mobile conclusion-first order.
route_adapters.ppt: Use native text, chart, and vector objects; no screenshot-only slide for editable delivery.
route_adapters.frontend-ui: Use annotation layer only around explanations, empty states, or guided evidence reading.
